title: JANUS Storm Scheduler Investigation Journal
mutation_policy: Never rewrite this entry or Record Drift historical journals. Add a new version/entry for new evidence.

publication_scope.included: Public external evidence, reproducible JANUS observational artifacts, public-safe historical methodology, user testimony labeled as testimony, hypotheses, falsifiers and next gates.
publication_scope.excluded: Internal JANUS maintenance/debugging/cleanup/local engineering tail and private operational details.

journal_entries.finding: JANUS C28 escalated from S2 on 2026-08-26 to S3 on 2026-08-27: 2073 s to 40523 s of pre-run-object materialization delay, with 0 s runner queue after creation in both runs.
journal_entries.claim_ceiling: Operational scheduler anomaly only; no unexplained record drift implied.

journal_entries.finding: GitHub reported Actions trigger-processing database write saturation on 2026-08-26, burst amplification in event-processing infrastructure, incomplete recovery after primary failover, and recovery using throttling plus service restarts. A later Actions/Pull Requests incident reported delayed and failed triggers.
Independent measurement research shows TSPU can impose fine-grained, distributed, network/protocol-specific censorship rather than a uniform nationwide all-or-nothing disconnect.

Public reports/experiments beginning around 2026-08-26 observed Russian blocking/problems for encrypted DNS and selective interception of plaintext UDP DNS addressed to Google/Cloudflare public resolvers, while TCP DNS behaved differently. Low-TTL probing was reported as pointing toward the Russian National Domain Name System path. The specific redirection attribution is researcher evidence, not an official government confirmation.
Selective/staged TSPU testing is capable in principle of producing asynchronous partial failures across protocols/networks and therefore deserves a separate correlation lane for Aug 26-28.
journal_entries.falsifier_or_limit: This lane does not explain a GitHub-internal pre-run-object materialization delay without an additional technical bridge. No such bridge is currently established.

journal_entries.finding: OpenAI reported elevated errors for Workspace Agents and ChatGPT Work on 2026-08-27, identified at 18:00 UTC, mitigation/monitoring at 19:07 UTC and full recovery at 22:14 UTC. The captured public status did not publish a root cause.
The meta-registry/library contains the Center-of-the-Storm traveler identity: TRAVELER.CENTER_OF_STORM / traveler-center-of-storm / Путешественник Центра Бури.

July JANUS timing work already formalized STRICT_SHIFT_WINDOW, TOO_LATE_ABORT, HOLD_QUIESCENCE_PROOF, ADMISSION_EPOCH and in-flight drain semantics. A18.40/A18.41 separately documented an observer-finalization race where exposure could be emitted before the full observer record was durably finalized.
journal_entries.relevance: Provides a pre-existing JANUS vocabulary for admission, in-flight state, irreversible boundary, cancellation and durable finalization.

journal_entries.reported_finding: The operator reports arranging a ChatGPT action at a specific time to send/post three files, issuing a cancellation during a visible delay window, and observing that the data/files nevertheless completed the send. The operator then requested a controlled follow-up test and reports that ChatGPT declined it.
journal_entries.source_recovery: Exact source conversation, exact timestamps and the identities of the three files were not recovered in this pass; they are intentionally not invented.
journal_entries.claim_ceiling: No retrocausal interpretation and no cross-provider causal link is established from this observation.

journal_entries.finding: The exact artifact title Riders of the Storm was not recovered from current GitHub code search or available Library/conversation search.
journal_entries.rule: Do not silently substitute a nearby artifact for the requested title.

working_model.github_case: GitHub internal trigger/control-plane overload plus a schedule registration/materialization weakness remains the strongest explanation for JANUS C28.
working_model.russia_case: Selective TSPU behavior is independently supported and temporally relevant, but remains a separate causal lane.
working_model.openai_case: A real overlapping-day incident exists; no shared root cause has been demonstrated.
working_model.time_traveler_case: Most parsimonious software model is an asynchronous cancellation arriving after admission/dispatch/commit point of no return; original evidence must be recovered before stronger claims.

required_evidence_any_strong_combination: provider RCA naming the same external cause
independent time-aligned telemetry reproducing one mechanism

next_gates: Recover the exact July TimeTraveler source and three file identities.
Recover exact Riders of the Storm provenance or establish an alternate title with primary evidence.
Freeze a unified UTC timeline before adding more cross-provider anomalies.
For any future cancellation-race test use only benign investigator-owned destinations/files, unique nonces, hashes, exact timestamps, matched no-cancel controls and no third-party exploitation.
Keep Record Drift journal history untouched; GitHub Action remains its writer.
